scope: Corollary 7.6 (Automatic terminal flexible decisions) of the manuscript “Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps” (preprints/Metric-measure-limits-of-subcritical-FK-and-spanning-tree-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 53. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an enclosing mutable interval strictly inside a positive quadrant excursion and freeze the exterior prefix and suffix. There are positive constants c1, c2 and a terminal collar such that, in a sufficiently small contour tube, all mutable paths stay above mi = ⌊ci √ N⌋, and all provisionally resolved suffix heights in that collar are at most mi. If the mutable interval ends at the fixed suffix entrance heights and the imposed suffix decisions are correct before the collar, every decision in the collar is correct. Consequently the resampled word is empty precisely when its imposed heights stay nonnegative and end at zero.
